tasks.label: yamt: run the merge window
tasks.detail: Start the merge window (just dev-web), then open http://localhost:5173 in GNOME Web. Running it again restarts it with the current code; an open page reloads itself. Stop it with Ctrl+C in its terminal.

tasks.label: golden: build conflict repo
tasks.detail: Rebuild one of the 10 real conflicts as a git repo in /tmp/yamt-<case>, to open it in WebStorm/PhpStorm.

tasks.label: merge: new conflict project
tasks.detail: Replace /tmp/yamt-conflict-project with Taskboard, a TypeScript kanban app mid-merge: 7 conflicts incl. a long file, a binary and a delete; one merge-made TypeScript error and one oxlint warning; see scripts/demo-repo.sh. Installs typescript-language-server once into ~/.cache/yamt (needs the network the first time; scripts/lsp-servers.sh).

tasks.label: merge: open in WebStorm
tasks.detail: Open /tmp/yamt-conflict-project (Taskboard mid-merge, see scripts/demo-repo.sh; made first if missing) in WebStorm; then Git → Resolve Conflicts.

tasks.label: merge: open in yamt
tasks.detail: Build yamt (debug, pages built in) from the current code and open it on /tmp/yamt-conflict-project (Taskboard mid-merge, see scripts/demo-repo.sh; made first if missing), with ~/.cache/yamt/servers-path first on PATH (scripts/lsp-servers.sh --path) so typescript-language-server is found. The first time, yamt asks whether to start the project's language servers. Running it again closes the open yamt window and rebuilds. The terminal shows yamt's exit status when you close it.
tasks.command: test -d /tmp/yamt-conflict-project/.git || scripts/demo-repo.sh /tmp/yamt-conflict-project; PATH="$(scripts/lsp-servers.sh --path):$PATH" just app --repo /tmp/yamt-conflict-project; echo "yamt exit status: $?"

tasks.label: lsp: new conflict project
tasks.detail: Replace /tmp/yamt-lsp-project with a fresh repo in the middle of a merge: one project per language (web/ with TypeScript, Vue, oxlint and oxfmt; biome/; py/ with ruff, ty and basedpyright; rs/ for rust-analyzer; go/ for gopls; php/ for Phpactor or Intelephense; c/ for clangd), each with a conflicted file and, outside the conflicts, one problem per server and a badly formatted line; web/src/greet.ts is the one conflicted file with no seeds. Installs the pinned servers once into ~/.cache/yamt (needs the network the first time; scripts/lsp-servers.sh) and prints the PATH line yamt runs with. Your settings file is not touched.

tasks.label: lsp: open in yamt
tasks.detail: Build yamt (debug, pages built in) from the current code and open it on /tmp/yamt-lsp-project (made first if missing), with ~/.cache/yamt/servers-path first on PATH (scripts/lsp-servers.sh --path) so the installed servers are found. The first time, yamt asks whether to start the project's language servers; the answer is kept for that folder (Settings → Language servers changes it). Ctrl+S formats with the project's formatter, then saves. Running it again closes the open yamt window and rebuilds.
tasks.command: test -d /tmp/yamt-lsp-project/.git || scripts/lsp-repo.sh --servers /tmp/yamt-lsp-project; PATH="$(scripts/lsp-servers.sh --path):$PATH" just app --repo /tmp/yamt-lsp-project; echo "yamt exit status: $?"

tasks.label: diff: open in yamt
tasks.detail: Build yamt (debug, pages built in) from the current code and open the compare window (yamt --diff): two editable columns, differences shown as you type; its tabs and texts are kept in ~/.local/share/yamt/compare between runs. Running it again closes the open compare window and rebuilds; a compare window started elsewhere makes this one say so and exit. The terminal shows yamt's exit status when you close it.

tasks.label: gitlab: open the playground in yamt
tasks.detail: Build yamt (debug, pages built in) from the current code and open the compare window with --ai in ../glab-yamt-playground, a clone of a real GitLab project (glab logged in). Its merge-requests button lists four merge requests: !1 conflicts with main (Resolve conflicts → merge window, Abort, Commit merge → Push), !2 merges clean, !3 already contains main, !4 is a draft. A row's Show Diff opens its changes in a new window with --ai, where comments can be posted to GitLab and each thread has Ask AI. Fills the project first when the clone is empty (scripts/gitlab-playground.sh). A compare window already open elsewhere ("diff: open in yamt") makes this one say so and exit.
tasks.command: dir="${workspaceFolder}/../glab-yamt-playground"; git -C "$dir" rev-parse -q --verify HEAD > /dev/null || scripts/gitlab-playground.sh "$dir"; cargo tauri build --debug --no-bundle && cd "$dir" && "${workspaceFolder}/target/debug/yamt" --diff --ai; echo "yamt exit status: $?"

tasks.label: gitlab: reset the playground
tasks.detail: Put the GitLab playground back as scripts/gitlab-playground.sh made it: its four branches force-pushed back (main is never forced; a merged merge request stays merged), missing merge requests opened again, and ../glab-yamt-playground on a clean main — a merge in progress aborted, yamt's record of it removed, local changes, untracked files and local branches other than main deleted.

inputs.description: Real conflict to rebuild in /tmp for PhpStorm
